summary.score_basis: Live site as crawled on 2026-09-15, before the same-day fixes. Weighted: Technical 22%, Content 23%, On-page 20%, Schema 10%, Performance 10%, AI search 10%, Images 5%.
summary.business_type: E-commerce: single-brand D2C crystal bracelet store, Dubai, UAE-only delivery
top_findings: WhatsApp order and contact buttons pointed at a placeholder number on every page
16 stone and 8 intention pages had 51-103 words; product pages were 81% boilerplate
No delivery, returns, contact or privacy page; delivery fee not shown on product pages
Structured data gaps: BackOrder on sold-out items, single image, no breadcrumbs or collection markup on hubs
556 KB non-responsive hero image, 4.5 MB of home images, about 2.3 MB of mega-menu prefetches, mobile horizontal scroll
quick_wins: Hide WhatsApp buttons behind a flag with an email fallback
OutOfStock availability, image arrays, breadcrumbs everywhere
noindex the wishlist instead of blocking it in robots.txt
Git-based sitemap lastmod and IndexNow on deploy

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: True static HTML with copy, prices, canonicals and JSON-LD in the raw response
Clean trailing-slash URLs and one-hop redirects
Valid sitemap, every page within two clicks of home

findings.title: Hero LCP image is a 556 KB JPEG with no responsive variants
findings.description: 2000x1125 JPEG served to every device; 4.5 MB of images on the home page.
findings.recommendation: Generate WebP width variants and serve them with srcset and sizes. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Mega-menu prefetches every intention and stone page
findings.description: About 2.3 MB of RSC payload fetched on desktop hover.
findings.recommendation: prefetch={false} on menu, drawer and footer links. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Wishlist blocked in robots.txt but linked from every page
findings.description: Disallow with no noindex meta.
findings.recommendation: Allow crawling and set noindex, follow. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: No security headers and 10-minute cache on hashed assets
findings.description: GitHub Pages cannot set response headers.
findings.recommendation: Proxy through Cloudflare with header and cache rules, or move host. Open: owner decision.

findings.title: Inline RSC payload of about 90-100 KB per page
findings.description: Home HTML is about 250 KB for about 330 words.
findings.recommendation: Inherent to Next static export; revisit if field LCP is slow. Open.

findings.title: Sitemap lastmod is the build time on every URL and priority is emitted
findings.description: All 46 URLs share one timestamp.
findings.recommendation: Use the last git commit per page source and content file; drop priority. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: IndexNow not implemented
findings.description: No key file or submission step.
findings.recommendation: Key file in public and a post-deploy ping job. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Placeholder WhatsApp number on every page
findings.description: 971500000000 used in order, contact and sold-out links.
findings.recommendation: Hide behind flags.whatsapp with an email fallback until the real number is provided. Shipped; number still needed.

findings.title: No policy or contact pages
findings.description: No delivery, returns, contact or privacy page.
findings.recommendation: Add factual policy pages. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Nobody is named
findings.description: About page is anonymous; no founder, photo or experience.
findings.recommendation: Add founder name, real photo and years of experience. Open: owner input.

findings.title: Stone and intention pages are thin
findings.description: 51-103 words on near-identical templates.
findings.recommendation: Question-headed guides with definitions, tables and FAQs. Shipped: now 343-422 words.

findings.title: Product pages are 81% boilerplate
findings.description: The same seven FAQs on every product.
findings.recommendation: Product-specific questions; general FAQ lives once on /faq/. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Claims rule applied inconsistently
findings.description: 'Traditionally worn for' on 6 of 24 guide pages; six health-adjacent phrases.
findings.recommendation: Reword and add a test gate. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Stale operational copy
findings.description: 'Card payments coming soon' and WhatsApp-centric wording.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite ordering FAQ and page intros. Shipped 2026-09-15.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Breadcrumb navigation on listing and product pages

findings.title: Brand-voice H1s and titles carry no search terms
findings.description: Home 'Energy you can wear.'; care 'A monthly ritual, five minutes long.'
findings.recommendation: Descriptive H1 with the brand line kept as display text. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Product titles and descriptions exceed SERP limits
findings.description: Titles 63-81 characters, descriptions 183-251.
findings.recommendation: seoTitle (20-50) and seoDescription (90-155) per product. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Internal-link gaps between stones, intentions, care and stacks
findings.description: Stone pages never linked to intentions or care.
findings.recommendation: Cross-links added on stone, intention and product pages. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: SXO: guide queries return long guides, our stone pages were stubs
findings.description: 'X bracelet meaning' SERPs favour tables and FAQs.
findings.recommendation: Stone guides with facts tables and question sections. Shipped 2026-09-15.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Product present on all 12 product pages

findings.title: Sold-out products marked BackOrder
findings.description: Devotion and Aurora cannot be ordered.
findings.recommendation: OutOfStock. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Offers lack shipping and return policy
findings.description: No OfferShippingDetails or MerchantReturnPolicy.
findings.recommendation: Shared shipping and return policy nodes. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList on hubs, no collection markup
findings.description: Visible breadcrumbs without markup on index pages.
findings.recommendation: BreadcrumbList everywhere, CollectionPage on shop, intentions and stacks. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Product image is a single URL
findings.description: A lifestyle photo exists for every product.
findings.recommendation: Image array. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Ratings must stay out until reviews are real
findings.description: No genuine reviews yet.
findings.recommendation: Add AggregateRating only with real reviews. Open: owner input.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Fast TTFB from GitHub Pages CDN

findings.title: Oversized LCP image
findings.description: 556 KB hero.
findings.recommendation: Responsive WebP (15 KB at 800 px). Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Below-the-fold product images preloaded
findings.description: Four preload links competing with the hero.
findings.recommendation: Removed eager loading from grids. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Lab-only data
findings.description: No CrUX or Search Console field data.
findings.recommendation: Verify Search Console and watch field CWV. Open.

findings.title: No definition sentences or quotable passages on guide pages
findings.description: Answers not marked up as headings.
findings.recommendation: 40-80-word passages under question headings, definitions and tables. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: No dates
findings.description: Nothing shows when guides were reviewed.
findings.recommendation: 'Last reviewed' from git on guide pages. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: No named entity behind the brand
findings.description: No founder or external profiles beyond Instagram.
findings.recommendation: Founder bio and consistent profiles. Open: owner input.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Consistent aspect ratios prevent layout shift

findings.title: JPEG only, no srcset, no intrinsic dimensions
findings.description: 189 img tags without width and height.
findings.recommendation: WebP variants, srcset and width/height from a manifest. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: Empty alt on hero and stack-builder thumbnails
findings.description: alt="".
findings.recommendation: Descriptive alt text. Shipped 2026-09-15.

findings.title: AI placeholder photography
findings.description: Generated images without IPTC labels.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real photography. Open: owner input.
